item.description: In a landmark decision, the Iowa Supreme Court determined that Lynae D McMillen Dickey Tesdall, a co-owner of a property, must receive notice before any foreclosure actions can proceed. item.title: Old Masters Evening Sale: rare Altdorfer oil emerges after decades; expected to fetch up to £5 million
item.description: An extraordinary Renaissance masterpiece by Albrecht Altdorfer, estimated at £3 million to £5 million, is set for auction.
